title: Crumb and Bouguereau in New York
content: Today is the last day for the exhibit “R. Crumb: Lines Drawn on Paper.”The exhibit showcases Crumb’s irreverent and outrageous comics and sketches going back to the Zap and Motor City comics of the late 60’s. It’s at the Society of Illustrators at 128 East 63rd Street.Over at theHirschl & Adlergalleries on 730 Fifth Avenue, it’s also the last day for "Bouguereau & His Milieu," a small show of six paintings by William Adolphe Bouguereau. The show is a celebration of the recently published two-volumecatalogue raisonneof the artist's paintings spearheaded by Fred Ross, founder of theArt Renewal Center.-------
